mentions.name: Orate
mentions.description: This free public speaking app gives users a prompt and two minutes to answer, then has speeches reviewed by AI and other users, helping people train impromptu speaking skills through dedicated practice.
mentions.problem: Speaking eloquently off the dome is an incredibly useful skill that improves interactions with other people, and like a muscle it can be trained with dedicated practice until it becomes effortless.
mentions.audience: People looking to improve their public speaking
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building Orate, a free public speaking app:

• Users are given a prompt and have 2 minutes to answer.

• Speeches are reviewed by AI and other users.
